title: umbrella
$comment: The registry/TOC + capability owner. One per project-family (collapses to umbrella-of-one for pilot-a/PilotB). Single entry point: 'work on X' resolves here. Capability layer (connections/schema/query_library) is OWNED ONCE here and referenced by projects, never copied (kills per-project duplication).

projects.$comment: The registry/TOC: project ids onboarded under this umbrella. The single-entry-point resolves a name to one of these.

capability.$comment: References (paths/ids) to the capability layer owned here. Detected, not assumed (R8). Absent capability = N/A, not a gap.
